name: What due diligence should I conduct when buying an off-market waterfront property?

mainEntity.name: What due diligence should I conduct when buying an off-market waterfront property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When purchasing an off-market waterfront property, thorough due diligence is critical. This includes a comprehensive property inspection, evaluation of the seawall or dock condition, flood zone analysis, and a review of all relevant permits and zoning regulations specific to waterfront properties in Florida. You should also verify property boundaries and access rights. Kelby Contreras guides clients through these crucial steps, ensuring all aspects are thoroughly investigated before purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key due diligence includes property inspection, seawall/dock evaluation, flood zone analysis, and review of permits and zoning. A thorough agent will assist with these steps.
